description: 一次 context 请求到一次判别结果。CLI/MCP 只收集真实事实、保留 caller 生成的稳定 operation key，并提交 typed intent；daemon identity_gate 是唯一身份决策、approved recovery admission、外层 operation record 和 pure read query owner。四类互斥 invocation 共用本图：automatic context/recovery、fact supplement、approved identity recovery、operation query。只有 approved invocation 可携带精确 project/app scope、target identity、action、intent_digest 与 expected incumbent binding/generation 的批准；批准不是 token、endpoint 或 scope 所有权证明。approved replacement 在普通 Register token admission 前进入 daemon-owned transaction：从 project reducer/worker/credential owner 读取权威事实，本地 identity receipt 只作 cache；验证端点后只退役精确 incumbent，并由既有 Register owner 提交真实 binding。内部 admission proof 不是 token，也不伪造 actor_binding_id。普通 Register 与 authenticated command 仍保留 token/binding/generation/scope 校验，TOKEN_MISMATCH 只描述这些非批准路径。stable operation key 在首个身份副作用前持久化，绑定 project_scope、app_scope_id、target_identity、action、intent_digest；同 key 同意图复用，同 key 不同意图拒绝。phase 为 admitted、approval_decision、nested_register、route、credential、grant（仅显式 grant approval）、lease、context_complete；nested Register 的 command_id/operation_id 在 dispatch 前写入外层记录。nested receipt 只证明内层注册；route、credential、grant、lease、snapshot 各自仍由原 owner 提交。结果使用同一 discriminated schema，区分 missing_facts、approval_required、denied、partial、unknown、failed、completed、cancelled；automatic/supplement 在提交后阶段未完成时必须可返回 partial，终态失败保留 committed_phases，cancelled 只在安全边界出现。query 只读 durable phase projection 与 owner readback，需保留的 operation key 和完整 proof/read capability，不要求失效旧 token，永不 repair 或续写 credential、binding、route、grant、lease。repair 是单独显式 context invocation，新 key 与新 intent。identity/binding/route/credential/grant/lease owner 不合并；恢复 master identity 不隐式 grant/clear/promote，authority 流程仍属于 docs/dagpipe/collab-master-authority.graph.json。歧义、跨项目、伪造端点和真实冲突继续 fail closed。Cancellation is governed by this same identity operation owner: a context-only prepare_invocation reservation binds the operation key, canonical project/app scope, intent digest, and retained capability before mutation dispatch; admission and pre-admission cancellation arbitrate the pending ticket, and a winning cancellation leaves no durable operation. After admission, CLI SIGINT and the exact active MCP tools/call cancellation reach this owner without acquiring the identity_gate execution mutex. Cancellation may commit only at safe boundaries before a durable owner start or between completed owners; once Register CommandStarted or the authority journal grant-start event is synced, the invocation never claims cancelled. The context operation owner and its short arbitration lock govern cancellation; identity_gate only serializes identity execution. Register-start and grant-start evidence each remain owned by their existing durable journal. Implementation mapping (S23-B03 delta accepted 2026-10-09): outer admission/phase sync and authorized query remain owned by operation_journal.rs and its existing B23 dispatch; identity_context.rs binds the prepared Register envelope's nested IDs before consume and performs exact receipt readback; part_02.rs prepares the typed envelope from one consistent reducer snapshot; part_06.rs and part_11.rs route legacy and internal Register callers through the same prepare/consume owner; part_04.rs coordinates durable outer Validating (including nested IDs) before consuming that same envelope and queries the exact already-loaded runtime receipt. No operator topology or business semantics change. This is an implementation map, not evidence that the behavior is complete.
